response.overview: Filmed between the city of London, the Thames Estuary, and the landscapes of St Findlay's youth, The Whorl is part odyssey, part pilgrimage, and part love song to an increasingly industrialized world that doesn't need us. Financial districts, petrochemical plants, quarries, and former NATO listening stations form the backdrop as exhausted men in suits collect and drink river water, goths rebel without impact against the oppressive architecture of a post-war coastline, and a lone figure walks amongst monumental machines and down long country roads. Time stands still, cycles repeat themselves, the blades of turbines spin.
response.title: The Whorl
